name: sandbox_exec
description: Run a shell command in this session’s isolated cloud sandbox. Files persist until release or server expiry.

command.description: Shell command. Use sandbox paths; the configured working directory applies to each call.

name: sandbox_read_file
description: Read a bounded UTF-8 range from a file inside this session’s cloud sandbox.

name: sandbox_write_file
description: Create or overwrite a UTF-8 file inside this session’s cloud sandbox. Parent directories must exist.

name: sandbox_release
description: Delete this session’s temporary sandbox and its files.
